order

minNonefloat | date | NonevariableThe axis minimum. On a datetime axis, it's a date, e.g. 2025-08-25 or "2025-08-25T06:00". If None, it's the lowest value minus plot_area.gap × the data's range.
maxNonefloat | date | NonevariableThe axis maximum. On a datetime axis, it's a date, e.g. 2025-08-25 or "2025-08-25T06:00". If None, it's the highest value plus plot_area.gap × the data's range.

label

label

arrangement
base_axisxx | yvariableThe common axis for all series. Bars stand on it, and stacking adds values along the other axis.
stackingnonenone | sum | percentvariableHow series at the same location are combined. none draws each as it is, sum stacks them, and percent stacks them to 100 %.
offsetnonenone | side_by_sidevariableside_by_side draws series at the same location beside each other instead of over each other.
total
showfalsetrue | falsevariableWhether to write each stack's total when stacking is sum.
benchmark
data_columnNonecolumn | series | NonevariableThe column that identifies the benchmark. series means the benchmark is one of the series. If None, there is no benchmark.
valueNonetext | float | date | NonevariableThe benchmark's value in data_column: a series' name with series, or a date for a date column. The benchmark is drawn in the series.benchmark style. Set it together with data_column.
sidestartstart | endvariableWhere the benchmark is placed when it's a category on a categorical axis: before the other categories or after them.
legend
methodautoauto | direct | key | nonevariableHow this graph names its series: one of the theme's legend.methods.
key
positions[top_right, top_left, bottom_right, bottom_left][top_left | top_center | top_right | bottom_left | bottom_center | bottom_right | right_top | right_center | right_bottom]variableThe positions to try, in order. The key goes in the first one where it doesn't overlap the data.
insidetruetrue | falsevariableWhether the key is inside the plot area. If false, top positions are above the plot area, bottom positions are below the x-axis title, and right positions are to its right.
title
textcolumn_nametext | column_name | NonevariableThe title of every key. column_name uses the name of each key's column. Other text is allowed only when there is one key. If None, there is no title.
color_bar
title
textcolumn_nametext | column_name | NonevariableThe color bar's title. column_name uses the name of the series' color column. If None, there is no title.
layer
types[reference, note, error_bar][[layer type names]]fixedThe layer types that a GraphSpec of this graph type may use.
series
columnnamecolumn | namevariableThe column of values the series draws along the axis that isn't arrangement.base_axis. name uses the column with the series' name.
aggregation
functionNonemean | median | sum | min | max | percentile | stddev | stderr | ci | NonevariableThe aggregate. ci is half the 95 % confidence interval of the mean. If None, each row's value is used.
multiplier1floatvariableThe number the aggregate is multiplied by, e.g. 2 for twice the standard deviation.
percentile50float, 0-100variableThe percentile when function is percentile.
splitNonecolumn | [columns] | NonevariableColumns whose values split the series into separate lines, e.g. replicates.
ordersortedsorted | datavariableThe order of the series' groups: sorted, or data for the order in which they first appear.
colorserieshex color code | column | seriesvariableThe series' color. series takes the next palette color, and a column gives each of its values its own.
color_scaleautoauto | categorical | continuousvariableFor a color column: categorical uses the palette, continuous a color scale and color bar, and auto continuous for numbers.
line
showtruetrue | falsevariableWhether to draw lines.
stylefirstcolumn | first | series | solid | dashed | dotted | dashdotvariableThe line style. first is the theme's first line style, series takes the next one, and a column gives each of its values its own.
connect_orderxx | datavariableThe order in which points are connected along each line: by x, or data for the order of the rows.
interpolatelinearlinear | step_after | step_before | step_center | smoothvariableHow the line joins points: straight, in flat steps that change at the next point, before it or midway, or as a smooth curve.
missing_valuesdropdrop | gapvariableWhat happens to rows missing x or y. drop joins the line across them, and gap breaks the line. Lint counts both in dropped-rows.
marker
showtruetrue | falsevariableWhether to draw markers.
shapefirstcolumn | first | series | circle | square | triangle_up | triangle_down | diamond | cross | plusvariableThe marker shape. first is the theme's first marker shape, series takes the next one, and a column gives each of its values its own.
fillfirstcolumn | first | series | filled | openvariableThe marker fill. first is the theme's first marker fill, series takes the next one, and a column gives each of its values its own.
bar
showfalsetrue | falsevariableWhether to draw bars. Bars start at 0, or at 1 on a log axis, and the value axis then always includes that value.
value_label
showfalsetrue | falsevariableWhether to write each value next to its mark.
positionautoauto | inside | outsidevariableWhere each value is written: inside the end of its bar, or outside, just beyond its mark. auto writes it inside if it fits and outside otherwise. On stacks, values are always inside.
formatautoformat | autovariableThe value label format. auto uses the format of the value axis's tick labels.
